title: UI风格#62 - Retro Arcade (复古街机)
description: 创建第62种UI风格：复古街机风格 - 80年代街机、霓虹灯光、游戏机柜台。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBJ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When color palette Then features arcade neon, black light, electric colors
Given Retro Arcade style When typography Then uses arcade fonts: Press Start 2P, VT323, or Silkscreen
Given Retro Arcade style When layout Then arcade cabinet styling, neon borders, screen glow
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: CRT scanline overlay, neon radial glows, pixel blocks divider, 3D button shadows, neon glow text-shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade style When UI elements Then neon buttons, screen effects, coin slots
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: neon border flicker animation, 3D button press effect, cyan/magenta glow shadows, dark backgrounds with neon borders

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade UI When functional Then includes arcade chat, player agents, high score stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: game terminal chat, 4 arcade players (DEV_P1/RAG_P2/PM_HIGH/TEST_QA) with SCORE/LEVEL/LIVES/HI-SCORE/RANK/BUGS/FIXED stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro Arcade UI When copy Then uses arcade slang: 'Insert Coin', 'High Score', 'Game Over', 'Continue'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'INSERT COIN', tagline 'PLAYER ONE - READY', button 'START', greeting 'INSERT COIN TO PLAY_ PRESS START TO BEGIN_', status 'PLAYING'/'IDLE', nav with .EXE/.SYS/.DB extensions
